reasons: F01, F02, F03: material weakness specifically in revenue with an adverse ICFR opinion; the control failure sits in the highest-risk account
F07: the filing already contains a restatement, showing that past figures were wrong and the controls behind them are still weak

F08, F09, R13: revenue is mostly recognised over time with significant contract assets/unbilled balances, and soft assets are 95% of assets; margin and estimate judgments drive revenue with little hard-asset backing
R19, R10, R08: operating cash flow is negative relative to net income (-1.15) with positive accruals, so earnings are not backed by cash
R17: Dechow F-score 2.23, well above the 1.0 threshold
F19, F21, R16: covenant breach/waiver/amendment plus a capital raise and securities issuance create pressure to report favourable results
F22, R03: a major acquisition in the year and a large swing in asset quality (AQI 0.47) make comparisons harder and add purchase-accounting judgment
F12, F13: customer concentration (24% of revenue) on long-term programs raises the stakes of contract estimates
Mitigating: F04, F05, F06, F14, F16, F17 show no going concern doubt, no auditor change, no disagreements, no management turnover and no investigations disclosed at filing
